_doc: Trains (M10), read by js/sim/logistics/trains.js. A station is a KINGDOM store: what a train unloads there is in stock. `trains` are kept apart from `vehicles` so they never show up in a route's vehicle list. speed = x a walker on plain ground; accel = seconds from a stop to full speed; safeAbove = share of full speed above which nothing can hurt a train; dwell = seconds at each station; carry = goods a freight train holds; seats = riders a passenger train holds; hp = how much a stopped or slow train can take; gold + cost = to add one (half the gold back when removed). rail.per = metres of track one lot of rail.cost pays for; rail.shallow = the lowest water bed (height) a rail bridge can stand on; rail.yard = metres around a station whose town stores a freight train may load from; rail.minDiff = smallest stock gap worth carrying; appealShare / appealCap = extra settlers per person a linked bigger town has more, and the most per group. research = what it will need once research gating is switched on (M12; off for now).
